cases.title: Welch–Satterthwaite with one Type A input of 4 readings, k from the printed t table

source.document: UKAS M3003 The Expression of Uncertainty and Confidence in Measurement

cases.notes: The source multiplies the rounded k = 2.13 by 5.7, hence the 0.02 tolerance on U. The five Type B inputs (all ν = ∞) are entered as their combined value, which is all Welch–Satterthwaite needs. k = 2.13 is reproduced only with the source method: use the table row at or below ν_eff (ν = 20); the exact t at ν = 21.1 is 2.126.
